$comment: Variant registry for the release pipeline (ADR 0006 ruling 3 / D03-3, ADR 0009 multi-arch).
The .github/workflows/release.yml 'prepare' job reads this file and fans out a build matrix of
variant x arch. Each variant is one named asset set within a single version tag; every variant is
built for every arch below so each host runs a native image.
To add a variant (T7 / I1): append an object with its docker build-args. The pipeline needs no edit -
it builds whatever is listed here. Keep names product-neutral and kebab-case. buildArgs are passed as
`--build-arg KEY=VALUE` to `docker buildx build`; the Dockerfile declares matching ARG lines (T7 wires
them to real compile-time + image feature switches; today 'full' is the baseline with no switches off).

variants.name: corp-broker
$comment: The BYOD tier (directive 2026-08-03): sign-in is mandatory AND the identity
provider is BAKED into the image, so users cannot repoint the gate. Users authenticate
against the org IdP only; agent credentials come from the broker; no org token ever
reaches the device. Register the BYOD client as PUBLIC at the IdP (PKCE protects the
flow) so no client secret needs baking. AUTH_REQUIRED=false on any variant publishes
the gate off; every variant defaults to auth required at compile time.
